children: Propanc Biopharma, Inc. reported fiscal 2026 results as a development-stage company, with no revenue and a reduced net loss versus the prior year. Revenue was $0 in both FY 2026 and FY 2025, and the net loss available to common stockholders narrowed to $(19.79M) for FY 2026 from $(58.92M) in FY 2025; diluted loss per share was $(17.62) in FY 2026 versus $(371.22) in FY 2025.
Revenue was $0 for FY 2026 and $0 for FY 2025 (no sales; company remains in R&D stage).
Net income (net loss available to common stockholders) was $(19.79M) for FY 2026 versus $(58.92M) for FY 2025 (improved year‑over‑year).
Diluted earnings per share was $(17.62) for FY 2026 versus $(371.22) for FY 2025.
Clinical development: Advanced lead candidate PRP toward a Phase 1b first‑in‑human study, including selection of a GMP manufacturer and work on pharmacokinetic (PK) methods.
R&D expansion: Increased R&D activity and extended a two‑year POP1 program to support proenzyme senescence and fibrosis/cancer patent work.
Public company costs: Nasdaq listing increased public‑company expenses and drove higher consulting and investor‑relations activity to support market presence.
No product sales: The company remains development‑stage with operations financed through equity and financings rather than product revenue.
